title: 第21章 两位大人物都是来找苏尘的第22章 有眼无珠自取其辱
content_zh:
城主柳擎的到来，无疑给整个寿宴现场带来了极大的震撼。
万众瞩目之下，连威猛强势的叶震骁，也连忙从大殿之内跑了出来，在他的身后还跟着叶德元、叶兴龙等人。
“哎呀！
柳城主大驾光临，真是让我叶家蓬荜生辉啊！”
叶震骁极为热情的上前见礼，红光满面的说道。
要知道，柳擎乃是真武境九层巅峰的强者，修为距离玄武境也不远了，而且代表着大楚王国。
他本以为，城主府能够派人前来祝寿，就已经很难得了，压根儿没想过柳擎会亲自前来。
“还真是柳城主！”
“城主大人亲自登门，难道是知道了兴龙成功加入了武道院，来搞好关系？”
“肯定是的！
柳城主在王都内也是有人的，自然消息灵通！”
叶德元等人私下议论几声，脸上都啊露出了傲然的神情。
“听闻叶兄闭关有成，如今百岁寿诞，叶家又出了一位少年天骄，可谓三喜临门，我作为一方父母官，自然也该表示祝贺！”
柳擎虽然气度尊荣，但言语之间还是颇为客气的。
这使得那些宾客们，更加羡慕了。
城主亲自登门道贺，在整个北荒城还是头一遭！
以后有城主大人罩着，叶家北荒城第一家族的位子，那就更无人能够撼动了。
“少年天骄？那肯定是兴龙大哥无疑了！”
叶高阳和叶陵等人，都激动的看向了叶兴龙。
毕竟柳城主也曾在武道院修行，按辈分，还算是叶兴龙的师叔呢。

人老成精的叶震骁自然也看出来了，连忙冲着叶兴龙摆手道：“兴龙，来，还不快见过城主大人？”
叶兴龙眼神一亮，当即阔步而出，对着柳擎抱拳道：“叶兴龙，见过柳城主！”
然而柳擎只是淡淡点了点头，甚至都没多看他一眼，只是扫视着周围的人群，像是在找什么。
这使得正在等待夸奖的叶兴龙十分尴尬，同时也无比疑惑。
“叶兄，怎么没看到苏尘苏公子？”
柳擎突然发问，把叶震骁等人都给问懵住了。
“苏尘只是我叶家的一个赘婿，身份低贱，是没资格迎宾的。
柳城主还是里面请，晚辈在武道院时就曾听闻城主威名，正想讨教……”
叶兴龙一语双关，贬低苏尘的同时，还不忘抬高自己，希望和柳擎套近乎。
“我在问叶族长，你插什么嘴？”
柳擎不耐的冷喝一声。
他知道叶兴龙成功加入武道院的消息，但加入武道院的天才多了，能混出名头的也没多少。
一个小小的叶兴龙，还不至于被他放在眼里。
叶兴龙刚摆出的笑容顿时僵住了，只感觉脸上火辣辣的疼。
“哦？在那！”
这时，柳擎终于在庭院的角落里，发现了苏尘，再看了一眼叶震骁等人的脸色，历经宦海沉浮的他顿时就明白了过来。
“叶族长，你这后辈是该管教管教了，否则到了王都要吃大亏。”
淡淡扫了一眼叶震骁，柳擎竟然转身朝苏尘走了过去。
“苏公子，原来在这里，可是让我好找啊。”
柳擎热情的打招呼，看到叶倾城和林婉的时候也颇为客气：“苏夫人，叶夫人，你们两位真是好福气啊！”
content_en:
The arrival of City Lord Liu Qing undoubtedly brought great shock to the entire birthday banquet scene.
Under the spotlight, even the mighty and powerful Ye Zhenxiao quickly ran out of the hall, followed by Ye Deyuan, Ye Xinglong and others.
"Ouch!
City Lord Liu's visit really makes my Ye family shine! "
Ye Zhenxiao stepped forward to greet him with great enthusiasm and said with a glowing face.
You must know that Liu Qing is a strong man at the peak of the ninth level of the Zhenwu Realm. His cultivation is not far from the Xuanwu Realm, and he represents the Great Chu Kingdom.
He originally thought that it would be rare for the City Lord's Mansion to send someone to celebrate his birthday, but he never thought that Liu Qing would come in person.
"It's really Lord Liu City!"
"The Lord of the City came to visit in person. Could it be that he knew that Xinglong had successfully joined the Martial Academy to build a good relationship?"
"Definitely!
City Lord Liu also has people in the royal capital, so he is naturally well-informed! "
Ye Deyuan and others discussed in private for a few times, with proud expressions on their faces.
"I heard that Brother Ye has achieved success in seclusion. Now that he is celebrating his 100th birthday, the Ye family has another young genius. It can be said that it is a triple blessing. As a parent, I should naturally express my congratulations!"
Although Liu Qing's demeanor was honorable, his words were still quite polite.
This made the guests even more envious.
The city lord personally came to congratulate him, which was the first time in the entire Beihuang City!
From now on, with the Lord of the City protecting him, no one will be able to shake the Ye family's position as the number one family in Beihuang City.
"Young genius? That must be Brother Xinglong!"
Ye Gaoyang, Ye Ling and others all looked at Ye Xinglong excitedly.
After all, City Lord Liu had also practiced in the martial arts academy, and based on his seniority, he could be regarded as Ye Xinglong's uncle.
Ye Zhenxiao, who has become a mature man, naturally noticed it, and quickly waved his hand to Ye Xinglong and said: "Xinglong, come on, haven't you met the Lord of the City soon?"
Ye Xinglong's eyes lit up, he strode out immediately, clasped his fists at Liu Qing and said, "Ye Xinglong, I have met City Lord Liu!"
However, Liu Qing just nodded lightly and didn't even look at him. He just scanned the crowd around him as if he was looking for something.
This made Ye Xinglong, who was waiting for praise, very embarrassed and extremely confused.
"Brother Ye, why didn't you see Master Su Chen?"
Liu Qing suddenly asked a question, which confused Ye Zhenxiao and others.
"Su Chen is just a son-in-law of my Ye family. He has a low status and is not qualified to welcome guests.
City Lord Liu still invites you in. This junior had heard about City Lord’s reputation when he was at the Martial Arts Academy and wanted to ask for advice..."
Ye Xinglong made a pun, and while belittling Su Chen, he also promoted himself, hoping to get close to Liu Qingtao.
"I'm asking Chief Ye, why are you interrupting?"
Liu Qing shouted impatiently.
He knew that Ye Xinglong successfully joined the Martial Arts Academy, but there were so many geniuses joining the Martial Arts Academy, and not many could make a name for themselves.
The little Ye Xinglong was not enough to be taken seriously by him.
The smile that Ye Xinglong had just put on suddenly froze, and he felt a burning pain on his face.
"Oh? There!"
At this time, Liu Qing finally found Su Chen in the corner of the courtyard. He took another look at the faces of Ye Zhenxiao and others. After experiencing the ups and downs of the officialdom, he immediately understood.
"Clan Leader Ye, it's time for you, the younger generation, to discipline you, otherwise you will suffer a big loss when you become king."
After glancing at Ye Zhenxiao, Liu Qing turned around and walked towards Su Chen.
"Mr. Su, it turns out it's here, but it's easy for me to find."
Liu Qing greeted him warmly, and was quite polite when he saw Ye Qingcheng and Lin Wan: "Mrs. Su, Mrs. Ye, you two are so lucky!"
